```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Load in testing data
```{r}
madness_train <- readRDS("training_data.rds")
madness_test <- readRDS("testing_data.rds")
```

# Loading in the probability results of each model

```{r}
ann_pred <- readRDS("ANN_stacked_probability.rds")
knn_pred <- readRDS("knn_stacked_probability.rds")
decision_tree_pred <- readRDS("tree_stacked_probability.rds")
svm_pred <- readRDS("svm_stacked_probability.rds")
rf_pred <- readRDS("rf_stacked_probability.rds")
logistic_pred <- readRDS("logistic_stacked_prob_v2.rds")
```


## Turning into data frame
```{r}
madness_predictions <- data.frame(ann_pred, knn_pred, decision_tree_pred, svm_pred, rf_pred, logistic_pred, winner = madness_test$winner)

# Split into 70% training and 30% test data
set.seed(12345)
train_rows <- sample(
  1:nrow(madness_predictions),
  size = 0.70 * nrow(madness_predictions)
)

train_predictions <- madness_predictions[train_rows, ]
test_predictions  <- madness_predictions[-train_rows, ]


```


# Running decision tree

```{r}
library(C50)

stacked_model <- C5.0(as.factor(winner) ~ ., data = train_predictions)
plot(stacked_model)
```


# Confusion matrix?

```{r}
stacked_pred <- predict(stacked_model, test_predictions)

library(caret)
stacked_confusion <- confusionMatrix(
  as.factor(stacked_pred),
  as.factor(test_predictions$winner),
  positive = "1"
)

stacked_confusion
```


# Saving Files
```{r}
saveRDS(stacked_confusion, "stacked_confusion.rds")
```
